reply:
Thanks for flagging this — yes, this is a known issue. Our team has confirmed that CSV export occasionally omits the "Assignee" column entirely, or shows only one assignee, when a task has more than one assignee (tracked internally as KI-101). A fix is expected in an upcoming release.

In the meantime, the workaround is to use JSON export instead of CSV — it correctly includes all assignees for multi-assignee tasks. You can find both export options under Settings > Export, where you can choose the format and date range; the file will be emailed to you as a download link within about 10 minutes.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thanks for your patience while we get this fixed!
